title: a declared dependency orders ahead of ascending annotator name
manifest_yaml:
agent_control_specification_version: 0.5.0-alpha.1
policies:
  p:
    type: rego
    query: data.acs.verdict
intervention_points:
  input:
    policy:
      id: p
    policy_target: $snap.input
    annotations:
      alpha:
        needs: [zebra]
        from: $pi.annotations.zebra.value
      zebra:
        from: $target.text
annotators:
  alpha:
    type: classifier
  zebra:
    type: classifier
